summary: Return native completion audit receipts and persistence states (S4)

delivery.outcome: Return an immutable, identity-bound audit receipt from public complete(), observing the existing archive/journal commits for every actual attempt without a second logger or provider retry.
nonGoals: No provider, policy, dependency, consumer lock or release mutation.
No implementation claims for S3 or S5-S7.

architecture.decision: Reuse native interaction_context, InteractionStore and usage.record_attempt. Context-local observation collects only acknowledged archive finishes and committed journal row IDs; frozen dataclasses expose states and references without payloads, secrets or filesystem paths.
interfaceChanges: Optional additive CompletionResponse.audit with immutable per-attempt journal/archive references and stored/unavailable/disabled states.
architecture.rollback: Revert the additive audit observation and response field; existing journal/archive formats remain compatible.

commands: Focused audit tests with actual SQLite/archive readback
validation.evidence: Receipts reference only committed rows and completed archive documents; public fields are immutable and exclude payloads/paths.

commands: Archive/journal fault tests and missing final row tests
validation.evidence: Storage failures preserve the provider result, correct unavailable/disabled state and exactly one invocation per planned attempt.

commands: Fallback, nested and concurrent request tests
validation.evidence: All attempts share the request correlation without crossing request references.

commands: Affected SDK/archive, usage, client and native transport regression tests
Protected local OneDev and independent exact-head Validator
validation.evidence: Preserved compatibility and trusted merge of the material S4 implementation.
